core_obligations: First inequality (proof lines 643-645): alpha := supstrict of member ranks satisfies alpha <= rank(A) by the member-rank lemma.
Second inequality (lines 645-648): for x in A, rank(x) in alpha puts x inside V_alpha via the hierarchy-rank characterisation; so A is covered by V_alpha and rank(A) <= alpha.
Conclusion (line 649): antisymmetry of the ordinal order closes the equality.
proof_roadmap: Cover A by V_alpha to bound rank(A) by alpha.
